author: Michael ET.

title: Does the bare minimum
body:
Does what it should, there are more engaging apps out there. I hope this feedback helps the developers to improve their offer.

First a few positive points: 
- the app doesn’t crash
- the counting works 
- I like the sounds of the different orchestral instruments when you add a count
- basic weekly overview in a list shown with bars 
- 16 pre-set colours to organise your habits 

The main shortcomings: 
- lacks Motivation: From a psychological perspective, a little celebratory animation or other positive affirmation when a set goal is met is one of the key motivators to continue. In this app, however, you only grow your coloured bars with a little Feedback sound when you tap for a count. A final sound or animation upon completion of a set goal is missing entirely. 

- cannot select specific days for my habits: I also miss an option to select specific days per week or month for my tasks. This feels like an established standard amongst these kinds of apps (i actually checked quite a few) so how is this still missing here? I found a workaround by setting an overall count for a weekly routine. However, this feels like an essential to me since you buy this app to stay on track or form of specific habits.

- CoNstant nagging: you constantly get nagged to buy the full bundle off apps by the developers. I checked it, I don’t need it, I told you so - please stop!

- Rip-off: Last massive minus point for the price: almost 60€ for an annual subscription??? That‘s ridiculous for an app that merely counts, especially considering the shortcomings above. I bought other apps for that price that offer literally everything you can ask for, including video content (also including famous people, like established authors), guided courses, beautiful animations etc. to keep you engaged. This 60€ for this app is a rip off and I immediately discontinued my Subscription once I had paid the introductory offer price of about 10€/first year. I‘m still disappointed as some features are definitely missing and not well thought out. I wish I had chosen a different app.
